newsitem.title: UK: European bunkers steady in moderate demand.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers steady in moderate demand.

text.p: European bunker prices were mainly steady to slightly softer on Tuesday in quiet trade, dealers said.
"Avails are relatively good and there is moderate demand after the holiday weekend," one broker said, noting that fuel oil was softening.
Rotterdam 380 cst was slightly lower at $80/82 a tonne, with 180 cst also $1-2 down at $86-88.
Antwerp prices were about $1 above Rotterdam.
In Hamburg 380 cst was priced at $90/91 and 180 cst at $97/99.
Mediterranean prices were also mainly steady, with Piraeus 380 cst at $90/92 and Fos at $86/88.
